issues.reason: `(Possession thief_of_time time)` is possessed-first, so it asserts the false claim that time possesses the thief, and the genitive rule's own exclusions ('about'-phrase, measure, partitive) show an of-PP naming the nominalization's OBJECT is not a possessive genitive.

The half that stands is that no licensed shape (compound action, phrasal verb, modifier_noun / adjective+noun kind, possessive NP, agent-nominalization) authorizes an N + of-PP compound or the decomposition atoms hung off it; the half that falls is that fusing is itself illicit — keeping a non-compositional multi-word predicate as one surface symbol is exactly the idiom / phrasal-verb precedent ('keeping every word', 'never unpacked'), and the fused symbol alone asserts nothing false.

`(Inheritance thief_of_time thief)` at 1.0/0.99 chains with statement 0 to derive `(Inheritance friend thief)` — friends are literally thieves — which the text never states and which is false; this is the same error the idiom rule forbids ('never unpacked into a literal event — asserts physical beans the text never introduced'), and non-compositional compounds emit no genus.

gaps_confirmed: metaphorical / figurative copular predication (aphorism) — nothing distinguishes a figurative kind-predication from a literal one or lowers its commitment

predicate nominal with an of-PP complement naming the nominalization's object ('thieves of time') — no licensed encoding: the genitive rule excludes object of-phrases and `thief` fails the agent-nominalization suffix test
repair_summary: Removed `tot_poss` — the of-PP is the nominalization's object, not a genitive, and possessed-first ordering made the atom assert the false converse. Removed `tot_genus` — the figurative compound is non-compositional, so its genus derives the unstated, false 'friends are thieves'.
notes: The surviving line is unchanged: bare-plural subject → `Inheritance` at the empirical-generic 0.9/0.9, with `thief_of_time` kept whole as an opaque surface symbol per the idiom precedent.
